name: Dad Jokes
tagline: Random dad jokes with search, Slack, and Discord integrations
description: A free public API that serves dad jokes as JSON, plain text, or HTML. Developers can fetch a random joke, look up a joke by ID, or search by term with pagination. The service also offers Slack and Discord bot integrations and requires only a custom User-Agent header for identification—no API key.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth. Send Accept: application/json (or text/plain) and a custom User-Agent identifying your app; optional User-Agent with contact URL is recommended.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no published request quota

example.response_snippet: {"id":"R7UfaahVfFd","joke":"My dog used to chase people on a bike a lot. It got so bad I had to take his bike away.","status":200}

use_cases: fetch a random dad joke for a bot or app
search dad jokes by keyword with pagination
get a specific joke by ID
serve plain-text jokes for CLI or Slack slash commands
power Discord or Slack dad-joke integrations
